_comment: NEUTRAL EXAMPLE PROFILE (not a real person). The owner's own profile is private and is not part of the public repository (owner decision 2026-09-30, D-026); the public export ships this file as config/profile.json so that build_decision_matrix.py, visual_questions_demand.py and the tests run. The published D01-D04 tables and the BQ08/BQ17 figures were computed from the private profile, so re-running them with this example gives different overlap/gap values. Replace the lists with your own profile to read the market through it. Skill names must match canonical names in config/skills_taxonomy.json. 'have' = demonstrable now; 'developing' = actively learning, partially demonstrable; 'structural' = would need substantial time/education to demonstrate credibly.
summary: Example: career changer with several years of business/marketing analytics experience moving into a data-analyst role in Austria; English fluent; German intermediate; developing Python, SQL and statistics.
_notes: Illustrative only. Skills not listed in any of the three lists are reported as unclassified by build_decision_matrix.py.
